t: An all-in-one electronics learning board with a color screen and mini breadboard.
steps: Buy the Explorer from Pimoroni, The Pi Hut, or PiShop.us. The board costs about 38 US dollars, and the Starter Kit about 67.
Connect it to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Update to the newest Pimoroni MicroPython firmware first and back up any files.
Try the on-screen menu of examples.
Open a button and screen example in Thonny and change the text.
Wire an LED on the breadboard and blink it with a short script.
meta: Open Board. From $39.95. A few stores.
